abstract: This paper introduces the application of broadband power line (BPL) communication network. Based on the measurement and analysis of electromagnetic emissions of BPL modem, this paper gives some suggestions on BPL application in home network and the EMC standards of BPL.

articleTitle: Efficient improvement of measuring system of smart meter and design of broadband EMI filter
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: Electromagnetic disturbance is a troublesome problem to test engineer, especial for RF measuring system. The propagating characteristics and conducting routing of Electromagnetic noise from the RF radiated susceptibility (RS) testing system of smart meter are analyzed, a broad EMI filter is designed to cut off the conducting routing to refrain the disturbance of RF electromagnetic noise.

articleTitle: Using genetic algorithm to optimize double transmitting antenna on field uniformity in reverberation chambers
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) test is more important in electronic equipment. Reverberation chamber is also adopted as a standard measurement in IEC 61000-4-21. This paper proposes a method which uses Genetic Algorithm (GA) to optimize the field uniformity of workspace in a reverberation chamber which has two transmitting antennas. The result obviously shows that the optimization is better than before.

articleTitle: Prediction of far-field from under-sampled near-field data based on cubic spline interpolation in spherical near-field antenna measurements
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: A novel method to predict far-field from under-sampled near-field data which is based on cubic spline interpolation (spline) in spherical near-field antenna is proposed in this paper. Spline method is utilized to the under-sampled near-field data and then the spherical wave expansion is used to calculate the far-field pattern. Simulation results show that the higher far-field pattern accuracy can be obtained by adopting the proposed spline method compared with the piecewise-cubic Hermite interpolation (pchip) method. Hence, the proposed spline method has more advantages and practicability in the spherical near-field measurements of under sampling.

articleTitle: An adaptive hybrid indoor WiFi fingerprinting and propagation parameter estimation using RANSAC LASSO regression
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: This paper presents an indoor positioning method which based on wireless propagation model's estimation and hybrid weight k nearest neighbors (HWKNN). Firstly, the fingerprint data is optimized by RANSAC LASSO algorithm. Then, the optimized fingerprint data is used to estimate the position of each WiFi access point (AP) and the parameters of the wireless propagation model. At last, the signal strength of each reference point (RP) can be calculated by the wireless propagation model and the user's position can be estimated by using HWKNN method. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method provides a more accurate positioning result compared with traditional methods.

articleTitle: SPICE model for analyzing EMS responses of multilayer PCBs with nonlinear loads
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: In previous work of the authors, a multiport Thevenin equivalent circuit was established to analyze the radiated susceptibility responses of multilayer printed circuited boards (PCBs) in the frequency domain. In order to analyze the nonlinear and time-varying devices on the PCBs, this paper focus on constructing the time-domain SPICE model of the frequency-domain Thevenin equivalent circuit. The SPICE model is established by using the macromodeling technique. An application example for calculating the induced voltages across a low noise amplifier on a multilayer PCB due to the illumination of plane waves, is given to validate the proposed SPICE model. The cosimulation of full-wave simulations and circuit simulations are provided for comparison and verification.

articleTitle: Measurement and analysis on electromagnetic shielding effectiveness of a 500kV UPFC valve hall
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: The 500 kV Unified power flow controller (UPFC) valve hall is a large size shielding enclosure with dimensions up to 135.9m𢈗30m𢈗14m. Its shielding measures is based on lots of steel sheet with a thickness of 1 mm covered on the surface of the building. In this paper, the electromagnetic shielding effectiveness of the 500 kV UPFC valve hall was measured for three frequencies between 14kHz-15MHz using loop antenna and another three frequencies between 100MHz to 950 MHz using halfwave dipole antenna. The Test results show that the electromagnetic shielding effectiveness of the valve wall are above 40dB, which satisfies the corresponding standard requirement in China. In addition, the effect of the door status(opening/closing), the alignment of the emitting antenna and receiving antenna, the emitting antenna to wall distance are discussed.

articleTitle: A compact dual-wideband monopole antenna with parasitic patch for 2G/3G/LTE/WLAN/WiMAX applications
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: A broadband T-shaped monopole antenna is presented with small size. The printed antenna is composed of a T-shaped monopole, which is supplied by a 50 ohm microstrip at the top of the substrate, a ground plane, an inverted L-shaped strip, which is stretched out from the ground plane, a rectangular patch at the bottom of the substrate. The new antenna is made and tested. In lower operating band, the tested bandwidths for -10dB RL of the antenna are from1.7 to 3.8 GHz, while in upper operating band, the tested bandwidths are from 5.0 to 6.01 GHz, which can cover all the 2G/3G/LTE/WLAN/ WiMAX frequency bands. The design details of the antenna are shown.

articleTitle: Horizontal diffraction based on parabolic equation with nonlocal boundary conditions
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: In this paper, the recursive convolution nonlocal boundary conditions are used in finite difference parabolic equation model to calculate the propagation loss of horizontal diffraction for complex environment. The correctness and accuracy of this model's calculation are proved by experiment results and MOM computing results.

articleTitle: A novel patch antenna based on surface plasma polarization
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: Surface plasmon polarization (SPP) has narrowband characteristics and multi-mode characteristics, we can use this feature to realize different SPP modes combination to achieve bandwidth adjustable. In this paper, we propose a novel patch antenna based on SPP. It is fed by a circular microstrip line on its bottom side. The final prototype of the optimized antenna has a simulation results show that it has multiple frequency bands; the master mode -10 dB impedance bandwidth of is: 1.47-2.3 GHz, Covered the GPS/Beidou navigation band and mobile communication band, corresponding to the scattering characteristics of scattering structure in different modes, respectively. The peak gain achieved by this antenna is 3.7dB.

articleTitle: Phase constant of SIW revisited with numerical SOC technique in FDTD algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: In this paper, the modeling of substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) is revisted based on the finite-difference timedomain method and numerical short-open calibration (SOC) technique. Two error boxes are defined to calibrate the parasitic effects of the impressed electric fields and the errors of finite periodic units. Subsequently, the approximately infinite periodic structure is realized and obtained from a core network of device-under-test. Hence, the complex propagation constant of SIW could be accurately extracted by de-embedding the error boxes. Finally, the numerical examples are presented to verify the accuracy of the extracted parameters.

articleTitle: Differential and CM component extraction to optimize the EMI filter
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: With the help of the special electromagnetic noise diagnostic equipment, the differential mode and common mode component of electromagnetic noise on the LED driver without the EMI filter is extracted. Based on the electromagnetic noise analysis result, the EMI filter is selected according to the amplitude frequency characteristics of the EMI filter. Applied the leakage inductance of the CM inductor, the EMI filter is optimized further to achieve the design target for the lower cost and smaller size.

articleTitle: The influence of sensors structure on measurement accuracy of pulse electric fields
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: The accurate measurement of fields is the basis of Electromagnetic pulse (EMP) protection. The influence of sensors structure on measurement accuracy of electric fields is investigated with finite difference time domain (FDTD) method. The results show that sensors based on dipole antennas are more accurate than those based on monopole antennas, which is because dipole antennas take differential input signals and compensation effect improve the accuracy.

articleTitle: Application of auto-reclosing residual current device in lightning protection for communications power supply
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: Lightning strike can cause the disconnection of residual current device (RCD) for communications power supply, leading to power supply disconnection and communication interruption. Auto-reclosing RCD can automatically reclose after disconnection and thus power supply is restored. Clearly, auto-reclosing RCD can help improve the ability of communication system resisting lightning strike. In addition, it solves the problem that without a supervisor, equipment cannot resume working in time after lightning strike. In this paper, the reason that lightning strike caused disconnection of RCD is analyzed. Then, we illustrate the working principle, performance requirements and safety problems of auto-reclosing RCD, and finally specific numerical requirements for auto-reclosing RCD are given.

articleTitle: A novel broadband dual-polarized low-profile antenna for 4G LTE applications
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: A novel broadband dual-polarized low-profile antenna is presented for the 4G Long Term Evolution (LTE) network. The antenna structure contains a metallic low-profile cone for vertical polarization (VP) and eight pairs planar dipole elements for horizontal polarization (HP). The profile of the dual-polarized omnidirectional antenna is approximately 36.8mm. The broad frequency bands with the S11 less than −10 dB from 0.93 GHz to 3.5 GHz for VP and with the S22 less than −9 dB from 2 GHz to 2.65 GHz for HP can be achieved with the compact volume. Owing to the noticeable low profile, broadband and omnidirectional radiation characteristics, the proposed antenna can be widely used in indoor roof antenna networking applications.

articleTitle: Analysis of scattering by a ship and its wake on wind-driven ocean surface
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: A new procedure for analysis of scattering by a ship and its wake on ocean-like surface is presented. A smoothing transition technique is adopted to truncate the infinite surface. The scattered field is expressed as two parts: one part is a given field containing the contribution from the boundless flat surface, while the other part is the difference field due to the ship and the finite rough surface. Multilevel fast multiple algorithm (MLFMA) is incorporated to accelerate the computations. Validation of the proposed method has been provided by comparing with the small slope approximation (SSA) method.

articleTitle: Tracing movement of thundercloud based on network-distributed lightning electric field sensors
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: According to the changes and characteristics of electric field in the atmosphere when lightning occurs, this paper used mathematical model to calculate the movement of thundercloud. The atmospheric electric field data during lightning were provided by wide-area distributed sensors. According to the changes of electromagnetic field at different time points of lightning process and the weight distribution of collected data, positions of thundercloud at different time points were determined. Then, interpolation polynomial and least squares fitting were used for compensation and curve fitting. Finally, the general movement trend of thundercloud was visually presented. Result indicated that the simulated movement of thundercloud was consistent with the actual one detected by professional weather radar. Thus, the method proposed here can serve as a new method for forecasting lightning and shortening the forecast time.

articleTitle: Analysis of the characteristics and impact of lightning on smart substations
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: Smart substations are an integral part of a smart grid. There are different new smart devices and components in the key systems of the substations. In order to study the impact of lightning to smart substations, simulation modeling will be used to analyze the damages caused by lightning and the lightning protection level. According to the analysis, the impact of lightning to smart substations differs from that to conventional substations in the following three aspects: the number of cables is reduced; there are short cables; and there are smart devices at the outdoor switching station. According to the calculation for an 110kV smart substation, high-amplitude lightning directly striking lightning rods is the main cause of disruption to the devices of smart substations; the impact of low amplitude lightning to smart substations will be considered only when it strikes smart substations of 500kV or higher; where there are line arresters and intact metal shells, the lightning intruding surge and inductive lightning will not affect the equipment of the station.

articleTitle: Indirect ESD testing for a myoelectric artificial hand
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: In this study, we conducted an indirect electrostatic discharge (ESD) test for a myoelectric artificial hand using a pseudo myoelectric signal generator together with a bio-equivalent phantom. The indirect ESD test followed the IEC61000-4-2. Through a comparison of the ESD test results between the pseudo myoelectric signal generator and the real human body, we found a high similarity between them, which suggests the feasibility of employing the pseudo signal generator and the bio-equivalent phantom in an immunity test for wearable robotic equipment.

articleTitle: Design of Schumann resonance generator and detector
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: Schumann resonance is generated by lightning with a wavelength equal to the circumference of the earth. There is a practical need for Schumann resonance generator and the corresponding detector to fulfil relevant researches. In this article, we put forward a design of a flexible, reliable generator based on micro control unit and a high-precision detector based on digital signal processor. The parameters of the device are tested, which proves that both generator and detector are of superior performance and the set of device is well coordinated. The products are efficient, functional and very convenient to use, providing a helpful tool for further study of Schumann resonance.

articleTitle: Research on the airborne antenna layout of UAV with ultra-broadband EMP source
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: In order to overcome the mutual interference between the Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) airborne antenna to reduce the coupling, airborne antennas are modeling, and uniform geometrical theory of diffraction (UTD) equivalent source technology combined with Feko simulation software was adopted to optimize the antenna layout simulation. The simulation results are consistent with the experimental results. The total coupling is only 2.85. This greatly saves the test time. This method can be used to predict and evaluate the coupling degree of the airborne antennas quickly and accurately, and can be of great significance to the experiment.

articleTitle: Predicting electromagnetic environment parameters of power transmission line with data mining methods
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: Generally, the electromagnetic environment (EME) parameters are always estimated by empirical equations. This paper collects electromagnetic environment parameters, together with power transmission line related variables where principal factor analysis and regression analysis are conducted using information gain and decision tree for regression, respectively. Statistical method is explored to obtain two linear independent EME parameters to be analyzed. Principal factor to both parameters are obtained using information gain approach. As a result, radio interference and nominal field strength share the same principal factor, i.e., the number of bundled conductors. Decision tree for regression models, which achieves low mean square error in this case, for both of the linear independent variables are depicted to better illustrate the rule behind the EME factors.

articleTitle: Meshless nodes definition analysis for electromagnetic numerical computation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: In this paper, the nodal placement of radial point interpolation meshless technique for finite difference time domain method is investigated. The first widely applied placement is a manner similar to the point-matched time-domain finite-element method, which is convenient for the regular node distribution. Another one is the Voronoi decomposition which is applied to nonuniform distribution. The point-matched method does not take full advantages of adaptive characteristic of meshless method for complex problems. While the Voronoi decomposition is time consuming for 3-D case and may suffer from the matrix singularity of the associated polynomial basis function. An alternative solution is discussed by utilizing hybrid application of the above two methods.

articleTitle: Low frequency plane eddy currents in conductors with various cross-sections — A hybrid analytical-numerical boundary integral equation approach
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: Various solutions to plane low frequency eddy current problems can be found in the literature, nearly all of which employ numerical methods like finite element or finite difference methods, and solve the problem on a mesh by evaluating the equations governing fields or potentials at discrete observation points. Yet, for the kind of problem under investigation in this paper, there is an approach which involves numerical approximations only for calculating the integrals involved (in those cases that can not be treated analytically) and for solving the resulting system of linear equations. This hybrid analytical-numerical approach combines a BIE formulation and a separation of the differential equation of an appropriate vector potential and can be useful to evaluate quality, residuals and covergence of numerical solutions. Since the in-depth discussion of the single terms in the formulation is beyond the scope of a conference paper, we will focus on the governing equations, the kernel functions of the BIE and on appropriate series representations expressions that faciliate the calculation.

Author Keywords: hybrid analytical-numerical approach Boundary Integral Equation

articleTitle: Multiphysics modeling of THz photoconductive antennas current
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: A numerical method for modeling photoconductive antenna is presented, which consists of two coupled studies optical response and carrier dynamics. We compared the plasmonic photoconductive antenna with the conventional in two dimensions. The results show that the plasmonic grating electrode structure can enhance the transmission intensity of the semiconductor material under the condition of less than the diffraction limit. It also can significantly enhance the transmission field strength in the semiconductor material and increase photocurrent several times.

articleTitle: HMM-ESD current calculation based on Adams prediction-calibration method
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: Electrostatic discharge (ESD) generator is the key equipment of ESD immunity test, and the discharge circuit is the core of the equipment. The circuit component parameters and distributed parameters have great influence on the performance of the device, which brings a certain difficulty to the design of discharge circuit. In order to study the effect of circuit component parameters on the discharge current, a double RLC electrical structure of the human body-metal model (HMM) is used to construct an ESD circuit. Corresponding differential equation group, which are used to describe the ESD circuit, are computed and analyzed by means of Adams Prediction-Correction Method. Through the necessary circuit parameters adjustment and simulation analysis, the current generated by the circuit is up to the standard.

articleTitle: The research on high accuracy reflection ray tube generation for ray tracing on concave terrains
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: A high accuracy method for the ray tube generation when reflection happens in some special terrains is proposed in this paper. This method is implemented in the ray tracing procedure to deal with the intersection of the ray tube and the special concave terrain simply and accurately. The method is compared with another published ray tube reflection method, which shows the proposed method can better deal with the reflection on some special environments. The theoretical analysis also demonstrated the accuracy of the proposed method. Moreover, the proposed method was integrated into our simulation system to complete the simulation in several special terrains to validate the method.

articleTitle: Efficient unconditionally stable FDTD method for periodic structures at oblique incidence
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: This paper presents an efficient implementation of the locally one-dimensional (LOD) FDTD method with complex frequency-shifted perfectly matched layer (CFS-PML) for solving problems of the oblique incident plane wave on periodic structures. By splitting only one field quantity Q<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub> and adopting the LOD scheme, the transformed Maxwell's equations are reformulated into a concise form. Compared with the split-field method and the previous periodic LOD-FDTD method, the proposed method has a much simpler scheme. The accuracy and efficiency of this method are verified by numerical results.

articleTitle: Verifying powerline emissions & immunity test systems per IEC standards & technical reports
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: This article describes practical methods to calibrate harmonics and flicker, and power line immunity test systems. The methods presented are derived from several recently published IEC Technical Reports.

articleTitle: A new free-space method for the permittivity measurement of walls in indoor environments
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: The propagation of electromagnetic waves in indoor environments can be influenced by the dielectric properties of building construction materials. This paper proposes two methods of measuring the permittivity of walls based on the improved free-space method. Compared with conventional free-space measurements, it solves the difficulty in measuring in narrow corners. An experiment to verify the validity of the proposed method was designed and implemented, and the results proved that both methods achieved high accuracy, which can be applied to the on-site permittivity measurement.

articleTitle: FDTD analysis of building influence on nearby CG LEMP magnetic fields
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: Cloud-to-Ground (CG) Lightning Electromagnetic Pulse (LEMP) magnetic fields around nearby building are calculated using the Finite-Difference Time-Domain (FDTD) method. Strikes to flat ground are considered. Magnitudes of magnetic fields are not much influenced by the dielectric constant or conductivity of building. When the distance between the building and the discharging channel d changes from 100 m to 300 m, peak values all reduce gradually, there is the greatest impact on the side of building near the channel and the lowest impact on the other side far away from the channel. When the building length l or width w varies from 10 m to 50 m, influences to the building top are obviously larger than to the building surroundings, especially to the building edges. When the building height h ranges from 100 m to 500 m, effects are mainly reflected on d, and the impact degree is also limited to d, and variations caused by h are much greater than by l and w. The phenomenon caused by the permeability of building also has relationship with d, but differently, the further the distance is, the greater the impact turns, the hightest impact occurs on the point facing the building center and above the building top.

articleTitle: Discussion on current waveform in non-contact electrostatic discharge standard
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: In this paper, the current oscillation phenomenon generated by the non-contact electrostatic discharge generator team R&D related to the electrostatic discharge standard was discussed. At present, national standard of non contact electrostatic discharge ESD part is blank due to the difficulties of repeats, Multiple factors are found influenced to the non-contact electrostatic discharge test from the box our team R&D, It includes electrode speed, discharge voltage, temperature and humidity. The experiment results that current reached the first peak time is about 5ns, After the repeats tested, non-contact discharge current waveform always have oscillation phenomenon, it's finding out difference from the contact discharge current waveform which is always positive, this paper provides the help to work out national standards of non contact electrostatic discharge part.

articleTitle: Measurement of current distribution on electrode surface of spherical electrode caused by micro gap ESD
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: Transient characteristics of discharge current were examined to clear the mechanism of electromagnetic radiation caused by ESD (electrostatic discharge). In this study, a pair of spherical electrode was used as the discharge electrode as a model of the ESD experiment and the current distribution on the electrode surface at the discharge occurrence was measured. The current distribution on the electrode surface was measured by a wideband oscilloscope with a shielded loop antenna. As a result of the experiment, the current distribution on the surface of spherical electrode showed a maximum value near the spark gap and decreased with increasing the distance from the spark gap. Furthermore, the measured current value was in inverse proportion to the electrode diameter.

articleTitle: EMI impaction by the TRIAC zero crossing detection trigger
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: According to the operation principles of the TRIAC zero crossing trigger, the turn on/off of the TRIAC caused the large EMI noise and failed the conducted EMI performance. After modified the turn-on rise time and duration of the TRIAC switching performance, the EMI noise was attenuated and meets the relative EMI regulation with good margin, which was verified by the experimental results.

articleTitle: Implementation of DWT in subgridding FDTD scheme
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: Based on the perfect reconstruction algorithm, the spatial-filtering technology using DWT is extended to the subgridding FDTD scheme. With the spatial-filtering in dense grids, coarse and dense grids can update at the same time step that is only bounded by the CFL limit of coarse grids. The numerical results demonstrate that the computing time of the proposed scheme can be significantly saved without sacrificing the accuracy.

articleTitle: Modeling of electronic attenuator in adaptive interference cancellation systems
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: In the design of adaptive interference cancellation systems (AICSs), the simulation model plays an important role. Particularly, accurate modeling of the response of electronic attenuator is crucial but is usually a difficult task since it relies on the exact fitting of the response of real PIN diodes. In this paper, the PIN diode response characteristics are firstly measured with exprienment. Then, the key parameters of the model are extracted by fitting the experiment data with the output of the model. The feasibility of this approach is examined with three levels of experiments and simulations, i.e., the response of the PIN diode and the electronic attenuator, as well as the performance of the AICS. The results show that our proposed method is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Diffraction loss of mobile communications electromagnetic wave in L-corridor
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: Diffraction loss exists in the corner of L-corridor in buildings. Both measurement and simulation show that conventional diffraction propagation model does not fit L-corridor. The diffraction loss increases linearly with frequency on 0.831GHz~2.661GHz, which is around 7~14dB.

articleTitle: Simulation of transmission line pulse coupling and the study of protective capacitance
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: Electrostatic discharge is a common interference problem. In the test of electrostatic discharge, the injection of pulse is the critical and important part. The probe is a key device in the entire electrostatic discharge pulse test, which has been studied by many professional people. Transmission line pulse (TLP) is now widely used in the test of electrostatic discharge, which is used for the simulation of the TLP pulse production and the coupling of the probe. In this article, the protective effect of the capacitance and magnetic beads are verified by simulation. Furthermore, a proposed method is given to improve the protective properties of electrostatic discharge. Some convenient selection principles are provided for the solution when a problem occurs in the actual test.

articleTitle: A novel effective metasurface in low-profile microstrip antenna
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: In this paper, a low-profile (0.5mm) antenna designed for wearable uses with metasurface as the ground is proposed. The new periodic metasurface is analyzed in detail to discuss its influence and performance. The simulation and experimental results show that this kind of metasurface has a significant performance to low-profile antenna, a strong bend tolerance, and a safe SAR to human body.

articleTitle: Analysis of coupling characteristics of hybrid electric field in the 750kV HVAC and ± 800kV HVDC parallel transmission lines
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: With the construction and development of high voltage transmission lines, the parallel erections of HVAC and HVDC transmission lines have emerged. The hybrid electric field under the parallel transmission lines should be accurately predicted in order to satisfy the requirement of electromagnetic environment. Besides, the coupling characteristics between AC and DC transmission lines should be carefully analyzed to well understand the interaction mechanism. Based on finite element method (FEM) and finite volume method (FVM), the distributions of electric field and space charges under the 750kV HVAC and the ±800kV HVDC parallel transmission lines are calculated in this paper. The coupling characteristics of surface electric field and space charges in flow field are analyzed. Besides, the influence of separation distances on the distribution of hybrid electric field and coupling characteristics are analyzed.

articleTitle: Technical errors and economic contrast analysis of shielded lightning protection plan
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: This article details the technical content of the shielded lightning protection plan and puts forward the technical errors and investment waste of the plan through the comparison with traditional lightning protection plans.

articleTitle: Analysis of stray field of actively shielded MRI magnet
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: Stray field outside of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) magnet must be confined to five gauss in a limited region. It's hard to high field MRI system. In the paper, calculation of magnetic field of MRI magnet is studied Approximate expression of stray field outside of MRI magnet is deduced Influence of shielding coil position on stray field is analyzed and an expression determining shielding coil position is given to cancel stray field of negative five orders.

articleTitle: Design and application of a directional patch antenna with enhanced bandwidth for an aircraft altitude measuring system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: In this paper, a back-to-back U-shaped directional patch antenna is proposed with both enhanced bandwidth (BW) and high gain. The proposed antenna is aimed to improve the bandwidth and guarantee the high gain and directivity, simultaneously. A step by step analysis is introduced into the antenna design. By the adding of patches, the current path on the main radiating element is extended. Better impendence bandwidth and demanding directivity are achieved simultaneously. The obtained impedance bandwidth (|S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub>|<;-10 dB) across the operating band can reach 300 MHz (4.14 to 4.44 GHz) for the C band with a peak gain of 11 dB. The proposed design has a directional radiation pattern and scan angle is not greater than 60 degrees, precisely demanded for aircraft height measuring application.

articleTitle: Compact phi-shaped tri-state reconfigurable dual-band antenna for wireless applications
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: A compact phi-shaped tri-state dual-band reconfigurable antenna for Bluetooth, WiMAX, and WLAN application is proposed. The reconfigurable antenna is fed by a 50Ω coplanar waveguide (CPW), and consists of three radiation elements embedded with four PIN diodes. Modifying the effective electrical length of the antenna by controlling four PIN diodes, the antenna achieves tri-state dual-band: state one with certain dual-band (2.4–2.4835GHz and 3.3–3.8GHz), state two with certain dual-band (3.3–3.8GHz and 5.15–5.5GHz), and state three with certain dual-band (2.4–2.4835 GHz and 3.3–5.825GHz). Meanwhile, the antenna works at three states with omnidirectional radiation patterns. Measured results are in good agreement with simulations, which denotes that it is suitable for wireless communication systems.

articleTitle: A wideband, wide-scan tightly coupled dipole array with parasitic elements
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: In this paper, a wideband, wide-scan tightly coupled dipole array (TCDA) is designed. The antenna element composed of a parasitic element and a horizontal inter-digital electric dipole, which printed on a printed circuit board (PCB) and backed with a ground plane. Parasitic element can expand the scanning angle range in E-plane. The antenna profile is very low, approximately 0.341 (λ is the minimum free-space wavelength in the operating band) and element size is 0.49λ. The antenna is excited by lump port with 170Ω port impedance. Simulated results show the design provides a 2.4:1 (from 1.85 GHz to 4.45 GHz) bandwidth while scanning to ±75° in the E-plane, scanning to ±45° in the H-plane, subject to VSWR <; 2.5.

articleTitle: Simulation and analysis of a small biconical antenna radiation simulator
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: This paper aims to build a small biconical antenna simulator with 1/10ns(the rise-time is 1 ns and the half-width is 10 ns) to meet the needs of a scale model experiments. First of all, on the basis of understanding the fundamental theory of biconical antenna, it presents a detailed analysis of the propagation characteristics of the horizontal electric field parallel to the antenna radiated from the biconical antenna, meanwhile, the influences of half-angle, radius, arm length and height on the electric field are discussed. Furthermore, the antenna dimensions are determined as θ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>=32°, R=1m, L=7m, H=6m, and the test area of the simulator is calculated according to GJB-8848. The results suggest that the test area is symmetrically distributed with respect to both the X and Y axes.

articleTitle: The environmental management for compliance with radio frequency EMF limits for radiocommunication base stations
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: This paper gives guidance on how to manage the compliance with RF-EMF limits in areas near to radiocommunication installations and how to establish processes for responding to public concern about exposure to RF-EMF.

articleTitle: Influence of microwave pulse parameters on the burnout effect of an LNA constructed by a GaAs PHEMT
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: In this paper, the influence of microwave pulse parameters on the burnout effect of a low noise amplifier (LNA) constructed by a GaAs PHEMT is analyzed. Through burnout mechanism analysis and simulation verification, the vulnerable spot for the GaAs PHEMT in the studied LNA is below the gate and near the source. The influences of the pulse width, the pulse repetition frequency (PRF) and the pulse number are analyzed by simulations. The results show that for a single-shot microwave pulse, increasing the pulse width can reduce the burnout power threshold; for a repetitive microwave pulse, increasing the pulse width, the PRF and the pulse number all can reduce the burnout power threshold when other conditions remain unchanged.

articleTitle: The application of NEC in 9 kHz–30 MHz theoretical NSA calculation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: CISPR A/AGH1 are using Numerical Electromagnetic Code (NEC) to determine the 9 kHz-30 MHz theoretical NSA values. The simulation accuracy problem of NEC is noted in CISPR/A/1101/DC. In this paper, the accuracy problem is analyzed over several NEC software. Extrapolation method and associated frequency parameters to solve the accuracy problem are established based on simulation results. Considering the nature of dependency of NSA theoretical values to the simulation parameters, a new approach to define the 9 kHz-30 MHz theoretical NSA values in CISPR 16-1-4 is also presented.

articleTitle: A measurement method of holding output voltage for air discharges of ESD generator
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: An air discharge immunity test method causes unstable testing reproducibility every testing due to many factors such as the approach speed of an electrostatic discharge (ESD) generator and climate conditions, whereas its method is being used as a mandatory test specified in the International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC) standard, since an actual charged human accompanies air discharges. Furthermore, the IEC standard also prescribes the holding time of over 5 s where the decrease of the discharge electrode voltage due to current leakage, prior to the air discharge, should not be greater than 10 %, despite the fact that the measurement method has not been specified. In this study, we propose a novel method for simply measuring the holding output voltage of an ESD generator with a commercially available high voltage probe connected through a wire to a small metal sphere for contact discharges and air discharges, the principle of which is validated experimentally. To show the effectiveness of the proposed method, measurements of the holding output voltages for two types of defective ESD generators collected from the market are conducted along with a normal ESD generator in a shielding room, in which a temperature and a relative humidity are changed from 24.8 to 29.3 degrees centigrade and from 36.1 to 72.3 %, respectively. The result shows that at an absolute humidity of below 13 g/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> all the ESD generators provide less than 10 % decrease rates in 5 s just after the trigger of the air discharge mode, however, at an absolute humidity of over 14 g/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> the defective ESD generators cause more than 10 % decrease rates, while the normal ESD generator gives less than 10 % decrease rates even at an absolute humidity of 21 g/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>.

articleTitle: Optimization of corrugated profiled horn with low cross-polarization
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: In this paper, a polynomial profile corrugated horn antenna is designed for operation in the microwave Ku band region. The structure of horn, combining the horizontal and vertical corrugations, has been optimized so that the cross-polar level in the 45 ° plane relative to the linearly polarized field vector is minimized during the operating frequency range. The performance of the designed horn antenna has been simulated. The results of the simulation show that cross-polar levels are below -30dB during the designed frequency bands.

articleTitle: Adaptive noise canceling for lightning electric field signals
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: In the measurement of lightning electric fields, both the measuring system and the electromagnetic environment inevitably introduce noise in the measured signals. When the electric field signals have significant noise levels, it is hard to recognize the weak discharge process from measured waveforms. Since the essential of the adaptive filtering is time-varying and self-adjusting, LMS adaptive filtering algorithm is chosen to reduce the presence of noise. Unlike many existing approaches, this algorithm has the advantage of requiring no a priori knowledge of the detailed properties of the noise signal. The results indicate that the algorithm can significantly improve the quality of electric field signal by suppressing the noise while leaving the signal relatively unchanged.

articleTitle: Joint predistortion of IQ impairments and PA nonlinearity in concurrent tri-band transmitters with a dual-up-conversion architecture
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: I/Q impariments of the I/Q modulator is an inevitable influence factor of the performance of wireless transmitters. The conventional tri-up-conversion (TUC) architecture includes three I/Q modulators, so when utilize digital predistortion (DPD) to linearize the power amplifier, the linearization performance would be deteriorated. This paper proposed a novel dual-up-conversion (DUC) architecture to linearize concurrent tri-band signal, which contains only two I/Q modulators and simpler than the conventional TUC architecture. A joint predistorter applied to this new architecture to compensate the I/Q imbalance and PA's nonlinearity together is proposed as well. Measurement results show that the proposed joint predistorter's linearize performance is acceptable for the proposed architecture.

articleTitle: A co-share channel for wireless power and signal transmission in short range
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: A short range wireless power and EM signal opposite transmission model is proposed. The EM model was constructed with CST, and the optimized results were achieved. In the results, the return loss is smaller than −10dB in the band 0∼250MHz and 1465MHz∼1475MHz, and the transmission coefficients is close to 100% at lower band, −2dB near 1470MHz, which is useful to transmit power out to LNA in the lower band, and transmitting the EM signal to receiver in the higher band.

articleTitle: Effect analysis of factors based on neural network in non-contact electrostatic discharge
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: Discharge parameters in non-contact electrostatic discharge(ESD) are affected by various factors, including electrode moving speed to the target, gas pressure, temperature, humidity. Mechanism of non-contact electrostatic discharge was analyzed based on a neural network model and compared to current waveform in non-contact electrostatic discharge measured with new measurement system of electrostatic discharge. Neural network method was used to adjust the weight of discharge parameters in non-contact electrostatic discharge based on discharge current waveform affected by electrode moving speed, gas pressure, temperature and humidity, so as to compare with the experiment results waveforms met to the requirement of international standard IEC61000-4-2, and to analyze the main parameters that affect discharge currents in non-contact electrostatic discharge events.

articleTitle: Application analysis on the simulation of the ACL for PCB ground net in EFT test
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: The EFT/B test is one of the EMC immunity tests, which aims to evaluate the anti-interference capability of electronic and electrical equipment to the EFT/B signal. As there is the ACL in the return path of high frequency signals, it causes the voltage fluctuation on the return path, and affects the normal operation of the circuit during the EFT test. The value of the ACL is one of the important factors, which determines whether one product can pass the EFT/B test. This paper analyses the principle of the circuit failure caused by the ACL in the ground network of PCB in the air conditioner, and presents the reasonable rectifier measurements verified by simulation and test.

articleTitle: Implementation of randomized MFIE at low frequency for multiply connected geometries
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: In this paper, the magnetic field integral equation (MFIE) with randomized method is implemented to solve the singularity of the MFIE matrix at low frequency. By removing the nullspace of MFIE operator, the nearzero singular values can be effectively avoided, thus reducing the condition number of the impedance matrix. Numerical results validate the feasibility of the method.

articleTitle: Research on the measurement chain's relationship of radiated emission and immunity with two system formulas
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: Based on the measurement principle of radiated emission and radiated immunity tests, explore the numerical relationship of key measurement parameters' transferring on the entire measurement chains, and two system formulas (RE field strength formula and RS power formula) can be derived and summarized. Combined with practical cases to illustrate its numerical calculation and understand the application through the systems' equipment selection of EMC radiated measurement, analysis of measurement uncertainty evaluation and measurement of FU/AN in initial site validation.

articleTitle: Applications of a reciprocity-based hybrid approach on EMS analysis of embedded planar capacitors and PG vias in multilayer PCBs
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: In previous work of the authors, a reciprocity-based hybrid approach has been proposed to analyze the electromagnetic susceptibility (EMS) responses of multilayer printed circuit boards (PCBs) due to the board-edge coupling. This paper focuses on its applications to estimate the performance of embedded planar capacitors and power-and-ground (PG) vias in multilayer PCBs for reducing external incident electromagnetic interference (EMI) to the loads on board.

articleTitle: A 28-GHz, multi-layered, circularly polarized, electrically small, Huygens source antenna
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: A 28 GHz, multi-layered, circularly-polarized (CP), Huygens source electrically small antenna (ESA) is presented. The CP radiation is realized by integrating two orthogonal linearly polarized Huygens source EASs into one with an asymmetrical arc strip feed providing the necessary 90° phase difference. Finally, the CP Huygens source ESA exhibits the properties: ka = 0.942; 1.41% FBW<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-10 dB</sub> with a 0.47% 3-dB axial ratio (AR) fractional bandwidth; and peak realized gain, FTBR, and radiation efficiency values are 2.03 dBi, 26.72 dB, and 73.4%, respectively. To confirm its efficacy for on-body applications, the specific absorption rate (SAR) values of the Huygens source ESA is evaluated and found to be very low.

articleTitle: Research on conductivity temperature dependence of CFRP
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: An experiment platform is established to measure the conductivity of carbon fiber reinforced polymer (CFRP). We research for the properties of conductivity of CFRP with the changing of temperature (conductivity temperature dependence) in different directions of measurement and analyze the properties in the light of conduction mechanism. The experiment results show that the conductivity of CFRP decreases with the increasing of temperature and the glass transition which is observed at around 190 °C has different influence on conductivity temperature dependence in three measurement direction. In addition, the properties of conductivity temperature dependence measured in the thickness and vertical fiber directions are different from that in the fiber direction.

articleTitle: Experiment and simulation analysis of BMM electrostatic discharge simulator
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: Human body electrostatic discharge, due to rapid development and large scale applications of electronic products and integrated circuits, becomes a serious threat to electronic system security. Human body-metal dual-RLC circuit model was discussed based on international standard IEC61000-4-2. Model simulation was given by software MATLAB and fourth order Runge-Kutta algorithm. Discharge waveform was obtained to verify the standard. Relevant circuit model was built up based on the new electrostatic discharge measurement system whereas obtained the relevant discharge waveform. Actual test discharge waveforms were compared.

articleTitle: A compact and wideband slot antenna with conical radiation pattern using artificial magnetic conductors
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: This paper presents a compact and wideband slot antenna with conical radiation patterns using artificial magnetic conductors (AMC). It consists of a 4-element antenna array and an AMC surface on the upper and lower substrates, respectively. The electric fields generated by the four slot elements cancel each other in the center so that a radiation null can be generated in the center. The AMC surface is placed behind the antenna array to enhance the forward radiation. The resonant frequencies of the one-wavelength slot and quarter-wavelength monopole modes of the square slot antenna element are tuned close to each other to achieve the wideband performance. The performance of the proposed antenna in terms of S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub>, radiation patterns, efficiencies, and realized gains are studied. According to the simulated results, its impedance bandwidth is from 4.99 to 6.19 GHz (1.20 GHz, 21.5%), and its maximum gain is 6.0 dBi at the elevation angle of 36°.

articleTitle: A novel wideband six-port correlator with filter-integration and DC-block functions
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: In this paper, a novel wideband filtering DC-block six-port correlator (WFDSC), composed of a wideband power divider (WPD) and three wideband filtering couplers (WFCs), is proposed A wide operating frequency range from 1.6 GHz to 2.6 GHz (47.6% fractional bandwidth) is achieved, which suits with current main wireless communication technology standards such as CDMA, LTE, and Wi-Fi. Based on transmission-line theory and coupled-line technology, excellent amplitude-frequency and phase-frequency characteristics are obtained with the functions of filter integration and DC block. A WFDSC prototype is designed, fabricated and measured for validation and there is a good agreement between simulated and measured results.

articleTitle: A novel canonical piecewise-linear function-based behavioral model for concurrent dual-band power amplifier
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel canonical piecewise-linear (CPWL) function-based behavioral model for concurrent dual-band power amplifier which called 2D-CPWL. Compare with conventional 2D-DPD model, this novel behavioral model has lower complexity and the parameter of model scan be estim-ated by least-square method. Performances are evaluated with a simulational test setup using MATLAB. The dual-band signal center frequency separated by 80 MHz. Lower and upper center frequency are respectively located at 2.61 GHz and 2.69 GHz. The results show that the adjacent channel power ratio (ACPR) is less than -59.18 dBc and normalized mean square error (NMSE) is around -61.31 dB for lower sideband (LSB) and -61.30 dB for upper sideband (USB).

articleTitle: Dual-wideband MIMO antenna arrays for octa-band WWAN/LTE mobile phones
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: This letter presents a novel dual-wideband Multiple-input Multiple-output (MIMO) antenna array with four antenna elements for octa-band (LTE700, GSM850, GSM900, GSM1800, GSM1900, UMTS, LTE2300, and LTE2500) Wireless Wide Area Network (WWAN)/Long Term Evolution (LTE) mobile phones. The proposed antenna element consists of a driven branch and a grounded branch, generating several resonant modes which can provide dual-wideband impedance matching and wave radiation. The LC resonant network is added before the shorted point of grounded branch, to introduce an additional resonance mode which can greatly improve the low-frequency band bandwidth of the antenna elements. The impedance bandwidths of proposed antenna element with S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1l</sub> lower than -6 dB over 740-1000, 1700-2840 MHz are obtained. High isolation performances among the four antenna elements in the high-frequency band can be achieved to meet the requirements of LTE MIMO technology.

articleTitle: Analysis of the effect of the periodic structure to the NFC antenna
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: Near field communication (NFC)provides an efficient approach for shot distance transmission. The technologies make use of 13.56mMHz radio wave and loop antenna. As we know if NFC antenna need to be placed on metallic surface in a small casing, the magnetic field will be attenuated. So, transmission distance will be reduced drastically. Using ferrite sheet in between the NFC antenna and the metal surface can counter the metallic surface effect on the NFC antenna. In order to reduce the cost of ferrite sheet, this paper show the influence of the periodic structure of the ferrite sheet on the antenna.

articleTitle: Mitigation of EMI in a coupled inductors-high boost DC-DC converter by programmed PWM
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: This paper studies the electromagnetic compatibility in a high gain coupled inductors DC/DC power converter without using electromagnetic interference (EMI) filters. Several harmonic control techniques have been implemented in switched power circuits by researchers. In this paper, an optimized programmed pulse width method by using the heuristic Genetic Algorithm is proposed. The optimization must allow reducing the output voltage EMI of the converter and complying the EMC standard limits. Mathematical description of the optimization method is reported and simulation results are presented.

articleTitle: The number of chained lumped-circuits for the physical analogy of half-wavelength power transmission lines
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: Half-wavelength AC power transmission (HWACT) technology has the special advantage of point-to-point transmission, and hence is very attractive for long-distance (3000km for 50Hz or 2500km for 60 Hz) and large-capacity power transmission. In order to implement physical analogy of HWACT lines, in general, the equivalent lumped-circuits consisting of some chained π-type circuits or T-type circuits are used in laboratory. The number of the chained circuits is the most important aspects in the physical analogy of HWACT lines. In this paper, the voltage waveform along π-type equivalent circuit is analysed for different number of the chained circuits. Next, the relationship between the number of chained circuits and the wave frequencies is discussed based on the relative error of the cascaded matrix (relative to the transfer matrix). For 50Hz, 32 chained π-type circuits can ensure the relative error of the cascaded matrix is less than 3%. The greater frequency is, the more the number of chained circuits required to establish good equivalence between the lumped-circuits and the transmission line. These works are instructive for the physical analogy of HWACT lines.

articleTitle: Active toroid nano antenna excited by an circular polarized plane wave
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: A novel toroid-structured coated nano particle (T-CNP) antenna with an active core (doped with rare earth ion Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>) is studied in this paper. It is demonstrated that the active toroid-structured nano particle, when illuminated by a circular polarized plane wave, acts as a strong radiator at its resonant frequency (around 600 THz).

articleTitle: Absorbing boundary condition for efficient 2-D WLP-FDTD method based on domain decomposition technique
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: We previously introduced a new efficient algorithm for the 2-D WLP-FDTD method based on domain decomposition technique. In this letter, the absorbing boundary conditions (PLM, UPML) have been applied in the method above. The numerical example indicates that the PML/UPML based on domain decomposition technique has almost the same absorbing performance as the efficient Laguerre-based ones.

articleTitle: Analysis of UWB pulse propagation in multi-layer and dispersive geomaterials with AH FDTD method
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: To study the Ultra-Wideband (UWB) Pulse propagation in multi-layer and dispersive geomaterials, we use the unconditionally stable AH FDTD method for analysis in this paper. This method breaks through the nature of the stability condition, while avoiding convolution process, which is an efficient numerical simulation method. Different pulses, mediums and geotechnical structures are considered and investigated, which produced a series of constructive results for protection projects.

articleTitle: Design of directionality of the antenna using two-dimensional metal photonic crystal
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: In this paper, a two-dimensional metal photonic crystal structure with rectangular lattices is designed. It is composed of a finite number of metal rods, which can make the antenna in the center of the structure get good directionality in a certain frequency band. It is different from the directional radiation of the dielectric photonic crystal in the optical band, and the principle of photonic crystal is applied to the microwave frequency band. We probe the influence of different frequency and the number of metal rods on the antenna directionality, the simulation results are compared and analyzed. It is found that when the number of transverse metal rods is increased, the directionality of the antenna is enhanced and the sidelobe radiation can be reduced. We optimize the design of the structure, so that the antenna located in the center of the array can get good directionality at 1.25GHz, 1.3GHz, 1.35GHz three frequency points. The design of the metal photonic crystal improves the effective utilization of radiation power and makes the antenna to get good directionality, it can be used for long-distance mobile communication.

articleTitle: Introduction and simulation of dedicated short range communication
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: Intelligent Transport System can improve traffic safety and reduce traffic congestion and environmental pollution. Wireless communication capability is one of the most important bases of intelligent transportation system. The main technologies include IEEE 802.11p based dedicated short-range communication technology (DSRC) and cellular network based LTE-V2X technology. DSRC is more mature, and has been deployed and applied in some developed countries. This paper presents the enactment history of DSRC standard in the United States, frequency band and channel division, protocol stack and MAC-layer channel access modes; and simulates the performance of safety related message and non-safety related message of DSRC under different conditions of node density, transmission power, channel access modes and routing protocol.

articleTitle: Evaluating hazards of lightning strike on stationary vehicles under overhead lines
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: This article examines safety concerns concerning persons touching a vehicle located near an overhead line hit by lightning. Two models of lightning strikes are assumed for the analysis. The first model includes the entire lightning channel and current distribution along the channel while the second model is a short channel of surge current injected directly at the top of the struck tower. In order to evaluate the effects of the lightning model on the shock hazard level, the transient current passing through the body of a person touching the vehicle is evaluated and compared to the case of a person touching directly the struck tower. An integral formulation of Maxwell's equations is used to model the whole structure including the vehicle, power line, towers, grounding network, and lightning channel. The vehicle is modeled as an array of metallic plates, while the remainder of the system is modeled as an array of wire mesh conductors. Computations are carried out using the Method of Moments (MoM) for surface-wire integral equation in a stratified medium. Results show that safety is affected more by the indirect radiation and induction effects of the lightning channel for the case of a person touching the vehicle than for the case of a person touching the struck tower.

articleTitle: Estimating the eavesdropping distance for radiated emission and conducted emission from information technology equipment
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: The display image on the visual display unit (VDU) can be retrieved from the radiated and conducted emission at some distance with no trace. In this paper, the maximum eavesdropping distance for the unintentional radiation and conduction electromagnetic (EM) signals which contain information has been estimated in theory by considering some realistic parameters. Firstly, the maximum eavesdropping distance for the unintentional EM radiation is estimated based on the reception capacity of a log-periodic antenna which connects to a receiver, the experiment data, the attenuation in free-space and the additional attenuation in the propagation path. And then, based on a multi-conductor transmission model and some experiment results, the maximum eavesdropping distance for the conducted emission is theoretically derived. The estimating results demonstrated that the ITE equipment may also exist threat of the information leakage even if it has met the current EMC requirements.

articleTitle: A study on the electromagnetic compatibility of 79GHz automotive radar
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: In the call of global frequency band, the 79GHz automotive radar has become a candidate for the global intelligent transportation system. It realizes high-precision target detection and high-resolution imaging by adopting phased array technology and microwave integrated circuit, which has a broad market expectation. This paper introduces the key technologies and applications of 79GHz automotive radar. Besides, it also analyzes the electromagnetic compatibility between 79GHz automotive radar and radio positioning, radio astronomy, amateur and amateur-satellite services and space research (air-to-ground) services. On the interference problem between 79GHz automotive radar and the radio astronomy service, it proposed laboratory semi-simulated testing method and field testing method to determine the appropriate isolation distance and emission limits to achieve the electromagnetic compatibility and frequency coexistence.

articleTitle: Optical music recognition based on locality-constrained linear coding and double distribution support vector machine
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: Optical Music Recognition (OMR) has received increasing attention in recent years. In this paper, we adopt the descriptor of Locality-constrained Linear Coding (LLC) and Double Distribution Support Vector Machine (DDSVM) to address music symbol classification in OMR. LLC can obtain stronger feature representation ability compared with original music symbol. Recently, DDSVM is presented to obtain stronger robustness and generalization performance. Therefore, DDSVM is adopted to improve the classification performance in OMR. Moreover, One Versus Rest Double Distribution Support Vector Machine (OVR-DDSVM) is proposed for multi-class music symbol classification. OVR-DDSVM can obtain high accuracy only using linear kernel due to LLC descriptor, and this speeds the classification process. OVR-DDSVM is tested on more than 10000 music symbol images of 20 classes, and experimental results verify the superiority of LLC+DDSVM to other algorithms.

articleTitle: Table of contents
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 5th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC-Beijing)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: electromagnetic compatibility; DC-DC convertor; radiocommunication; lightning protection; electromagnetic emission; power transmission lines; Wi-Fi fingerprinting; PCB; antennas; metamaterials; computational electromagnetics; FPGA; ESD; electric fields; and electromagnetic wave polarization.
